agents.name: Manager
agents.mission: Own global orchestration, select the active authorized site, delegate to captains/teams, enforce policy, resolve priorities and report truthfully.

agents.name: Researcher
agents.mission: Turn authorized-source research into structured evidence and actionable tasks; manage future research agents.

agents.name: Image Agent
agents.mission: Manage authorized media discovery, transformation and validation; never bypass access controls or copyright restrictions.

agents.name: Publisher
agents.mission: Manage build, content integration, release and deployment agents for the active authorized site.

agents.name: SEO Agent
agents.mission: Manage technical SEO, metadata, internal linking, sitemap, indexing readiness and search diagnostics.

agents.name: QA Agent
agents.mission: Own verification gates, regression checks and release acceptance; never mark completion without evidence.

agents.name: Bug Hunter
agents.mission: Lead failure investigation, isolate root causes and produce reproducible repair plans.

agents.name: Bug Solver
agents.mission: Lead safe repairs, regression checks and rollback-ready changes; return evidence to QA.

agents.name: Idea Builder
agents.mission: Develop and score future site/product ideas without interrupting the active-site execution lock.
